findings.requirement: container engine implementation and version are recorded
cgroup/resource-control availability is recorded without inventing CPU/memory contract requirements
evidence: current SandboxResourceLimits does not define CPU or memory quota fields
coverageEvidence: CPU/memory are observational for Phase 50-2 because the current canonical runtime limit surface does not require them

findings.requirement: captured output is finite and truncation is observable
evidence: BoundedUtf8Capture limited 8 input bytes to 4 bytes and set truncated=true

findings.requirement: workspace disk limit is mechanically enforced
evidence: TaskWorkspace rejected an 8-byte file against a 4-byte configured disk limit

findings.requirement: execution timeout produces an AbortSignal rather than an unbounded execution
evidence: SandboxResourcePolicy execution timeout signal aborted within the deterministic measurement window

findings.requirement: container lifecycle enforcement removes the sandbox even without downstream completion
evidence: lifecycle enforcement depends on Agent Runner timer semantics rather than a Docker daemon quota
coverageEvidence: DockerSandboxRuntime production lifecycle timer aborted and removed the sandbox through a deterministic DockerCommandRunner seam

findings.requirement: configured network is internal and managed egress proxy is running
nested-container and CI restrictions are recorded rather than assumed equivalent
coverageEvidence: environment difference is recorded; contract-affecting network/resource semantics are covered by separate findings

findings.requirement: If-None-Match:* rejects an existing deterministic object
SHA-256 FULL_OBJECT checksum is returned and equals the uploaded artifact checksum
GetObject ChecksumMode=ENABLED exposes ChecksumSHA256 and exact body
required metadata keys are lowercase kebab-case
required metadata fields round-trip with exact logical values
SSE-S3 AES256 is observed on the stored object
